reviews.text: There are treats in both the waiting room and the examination room, which has made my dog ​​no longer dread going to the vet, so I'm very grateful! The doctor is also kind and doesn't force my dog ​​to stay still, so my dog ​​feels at ease going to the vet.

I visited this clinic for a second opinion.

They conducted thorough examinations and listened attentively to my concerns, which put my mind at ease.

At the other clinic, they only taught me how to force-feed my pet medication, but this clinic taught me how to hide it in a treat, making daily medication much easier. I am truly grateful.
All of my cats and dogs are taken care of by you. You're always so kind and helpful, so I feel completely at ease leaving them in your care. Thank you!
I rushed in because I didn't know the cause of my problem, but they listened to me attentively on the phone, the examination was thorough, and the communication via LINE put my mind at ease.

My cat was suffering from severe sneezing and a runny nose, so I took her to this clinic on a friend's recommendation.

They gave me a detailed explanation of her symptoms and carefully explained the treatment options.

I was told that nebulizer therapy is also available for cats, and I'm hoping it will alleviate her symptoms.

I told the doctor and staff that both my cat and I dislike nail trimming, and they said they would accommodate us, so I plan to bring her in regularly.
They are always kind and thorough, and my cat doesn't mind going to the vet.

I took my cat to the vet for diarrhea.

The waiting rooms are separated for dogs and cats, and it's by appointment only, so I felt at ease knowing I wouldn't be intimidated by barking dogs.

All the staff were very polite.

The consultation fee included trimming of the tail hair, leg hair, and nails, which was a great help for my long-haired cat who couldn't go to a grooming salon because of her diarrhea.

There's nothing an owner can do about the poop stuck in the tail hair...

Sorry about the poop stuck in your tail hair 🙏.

The doctor examined her thoroughly and seemed very trustworthy.
The doctor explains things very carefully, making it easy to understand. The clinic is also very clean.
The clinic is very clean! There are separate waiting rooms for dogs and cats. The staff and veterinarians are all very kind!

I usually go to the Harajuku center, but since the Hatagaya branch reopened after renovations, I went there for my cat's vaccination.

Harajuku is quite a distance away, so considering potential vaccine side effects, I chose the Hatagaya branch, which is closer, and it was absolutely the right decision! They were running some kind of reopening campaign, and even though the vaccine isn't covered by insurance, they gave me a great discount, which was a huge help, so I wanted to leave a review. (There were no conditions for leaving a review as part of the campaign.)

The doctor and staff were all very kind, so I highly recommend them!

And most importantly, the fact that they have a dedicated waiting room for cats is a big plus for me personally.
